name: Fore Street
note: Wood-fired Old Port restaurant (brick hearth with oven, grill and turnspit) opened in 1996 by Dana Street and chef Sam Hayward; the menu changes daily.
james_beard: Best Chef: Northeast 2004 (winner): Sam Hayward, Fore Street
Outstanding Restaurateur 2026 (winner): Dana Street, for Fore Street, Scales, Standard Baking Co. and others
Best Chef: Northeast 2002 (finalist): Sam Hayward, Fore Street
Best Chef: Northeast 2003 (finalist): Sam Hayward, Fore Street

name: Eventide Oyster Co.
note: Big Tree Hospitality's Old Port oyster bar, known for its brown butter lobster roll; the original of two Eventides (the other is in Boston).
james_beard: Best Chef: Northeast 2017 (winner): Andrew Taylor and Mike Wiley, Eventide Oyster Co.
Best Chef: Northeast 2015 (finalist): Andrew Taylor and Mike Wiley, Eventide Oyster Co.
Best Chef: Northeast 2016 (finalist): Andrew Taylor and Mike Wiley, Eventide Oyster Co.

name: Primo
season: Into the first week of January; its site lists hours for July through the first week of January (spring opening date not stated)
founded_note: Wikipedia: Melissa Kelly co-founded Primo with Price Kushner in 1999; its site calls 2026 its 27th season.
note: Farm-to-table restaurant on its own small farm in Rockland; chef-owner Melissa Kelly, Italian and Mediterranean cooking, menu changes daily.
james_beard: Best Chef: Northeast 2013 (winner): Melissa Kelly, Primo

name: Scales
founded_note: Portland Food Map (June 2026): Dana Street opened Scales in 2016.
note: Dana Street's restaurant on Maine Wharf off Commercial Street, serving dinner nightly; sister to Fore Street and Street & Co.
james_beard: Outstanding Restaurateur 2026 (winner): Dana Street, for Fore Street, Scales, Standard Baking Co. and others

name: Standard Baking Co.
founded_note: Its site: 'Since 1995' (year at this address not checked).
note: Dana Street's bakery, in the same building as Fore Street, baking breads and pastries daily.
james_beard: Outstanding Restaurateur 2026 (winner): Dana Street, for Fore Street, Scales, Standard Baking Co. and others
Outstanding Baker 2018 (finalist): Alison Pray, Standard Baking Co.

name: ZU Bakery
founded_note: Barak Olins started ZU in 2000 in a Freeport barn and sold at farmers' markets; the Clark Street shop opened in 2022 (Wikipedia; its site).
note: Barak Olins's small West End bakery, baking through the day with grain milled in house.

name: Norimoto Bakery
founded_note: Portland Food Map (June 2024): Fujimoto launched Norimoto in 2019 and opened the Stevens Ave bakery in October 2021.
note: Atsuko Fujimoto's bakery on Stevens Avenue, walk-ins only.
james_beard: Outstanding Pastry Chef or Baker 2024 (winner): Atsuko Fujimoto, Norimoto Bakery
Outstanding Baker 2022 (finalist): Atsuko Fujimoto, Norimoto Bakery

name: Nezinscot Farm
founded_note: James Beard Foundation (2023): Nezinscot opened its café and coffee shop in 1987 on a farm in the Varney family for more than a century.
note: Organic family farm with a café, bakery, fromagerie and farm store; the café uses the farm's own bread, cheese and meats. Closes for a winter break around the holidays.

name: The Quarry
founded_note: About 2018: the Press Herald (Nov 2023) called it 'the 5-year-old restaurant', grown out of the Monson Arts residencies that began in 2018.
note: Fine-dining restaurant in an 1868 storefront on Monson's main street, next to the Lake Shore House (street number not confirmed); chef-owner Marilou 'Lulu' Ranta also cooks for Monson Arts residencies and workshops. Public dining days not verified for 2026.
